brief: Two separate pairs of bases, the pairs joined to each other only with side connectors.

requirements.evidence: 4 bases: pair1 piece:0,0,0;full + piece:1,0,0;full and pair2 piece:2,0,0;full + piece:2,-1,0;full

requirements.requirement: The pairs joined to each other only with side connectors
requirements.evidence: No base stacking or other joints. Intra-pair: connector:0#0,0|1,0 (pair1) and connector:0#2,-1|2,0 (pair2). Inter-pair: connector:0#1,0|2,0 bridges the two pairs. All joins are side-connector-double; meshClash clear.

finish.summary: Built 4 bases as two pairs (0,0-1,0 and 2,0-2,-1) with internal side connectors and one side connector linking the pairs (1,0-2,0), totaling 3 side-connector-double parts. Verified clear mesh and only side-connector joins.

lines.key: pvc-section-double  (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))
lines.label: pvc-section-double (cut 18 mm from 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US))

cuts: buy 1 x 10 ft 3/4 in Sch 40 PVC pipe, OD 26.67 mm (US). Metric 25/32 mm pipe does not fit.
- fit a BACKFLOW PREVENTER at the hose bib: this system is a cross-connection without one
- fit a 25-40 psi PRESSURE REGULATOR at the inlet
- drain the system before it freezes

result.note: No place on the build takes this part right now. Change the build so it can (for example add the cells it needs beside or below it), then ask again. Guessing raw ops for a part with no offers rarely works.
